Since EmbedController#best enqueues RetrieveTopic for any unknown embed_url, concurrent first-time embeds each re-run the full feed poll and per-item import inside the worker, a concrete performance/worker-saturation concern created by this design (not an outright correctness defect).

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in lib/topic_retriever.rb lines 38-41, perform_retrieve calls Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({}) which processes the entire RSS feed (parsing all items and calling TopicEmbed.import for each) before checking if the specific embed_url exists. This is inefficient - if multiple concurrent requests come in for different new URLs, each will trigger a full feed poll. However, this is an architectural/performance concern rather than a bug - the code functions correctly, just inefficiently. The throttling mechanism (retrieved_recently?) only prevents repeated requests for the same URL, not concurrent requests for different URLs.
